name: HSBC Visa Infinite Credit Card
highlights: S$1 = Up to 1.25 Miles Local Spend
S$1 = Up to 2.25 Miles Overseas Spend
Dedicated Concierge Service for personalized assistance
Up to 2.25 air miles per S$1 spent
Present your HSBC Visa Infinite Credit Card, boarding pass and quote 'LoungeKey' to enjoy complimentary access to over 1,100 VIP airport lounges for you and your supplementary cardholders.
Dedicated concierge service for personalised assistance.
Complimentary limousine transfer and expedited immigration clearance
Automatic comprehensive travel insurance coverage (including COVID-19 coverage) up to USD2 million.

our_takes.our-take: The HSBC Visa Infinite card targets high-income earners seeking premium travel perks but demands careful spending habits. While it offers up to 2.25 miles per S$1 and lounge access, a S$2,000 monthly spend is required to unlock the limousine and expedited immigration services. Consider if your spending consistently meets this threshold. The high annual fee (S$662.15) makes this card best suited for those who fully utilize the travel benefits; otherwise, alternatives with lower fees and simpler rewards structures may be more suitable.
our_takes.good-for:
Affluent travelers seeking complimentary airport lounge access and expedited immigration services for seamless international journeys.
High-income earners who spend significantly on travel and dining to maximize rewards and concierge services.
Professionals who appreciate premium travel insurance coverage and exclusive perks like limousine transfers for added comfort.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A steep S$662.15 annual fee applies; ensure benefits like lounge access and miles outweigh this cost.
The 26.90% APR can be costly; avoid interest by paying your balance in full each month.
3.25% foreign transaction fee applies to overseas purchases; consider using alternative cards if frequent.
